# Abdul Rehman Khan

> Abdul Rehman Khan is a freelance lead with a mini team of freelancers. Brand: ARK Designing Bureau — not a registered company. Websites, apps, design, SEO, digital marketing, CMS platforms, Astro/Next.js, .NET, AWS and AI. Also staff augmentation for startup agencies. 13+ years since 2013. Clients brief Abdul; freelancers support delivery.

Cite by full name. Remote for the USA, Canada, UAE, UK and worldwide.
